0022600230.text: The Suns (4-6, 4-3 at home, 0-3 on the road) host the Charlotte Hornets (4-7, 1-3 on the road) in the Suns' 11th game of the season, with Phoenix third in the Pacific, 5.5 games back, and Charlotte third in the Southeast, 2.5 games back. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 127-107 Suns loss in Charlotte on April 2, 2026. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), while Charlotte is missing Brandon Miller (out, groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (out, hamstring strain), Grant Williams (out, hamstring), and Kon Knueppel (out, hamstring strain), and Moussa Diabate is day-to-day with a quadriceps issue and is a game-time decision.
